bug_description: Null pointer dereference in dh_gen_type_name2id_w_default() in providers/implementations/keymgmt/dh_kmgmt.c when EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_dh_paramgen_type(ctx, 0) is called with the documented valid constant DH_PARAMGEN_TYPE_GENERATOR. The internal ctrl-to-provider translation layer constructs an OSSL_PARAM UTF8 string with data==NULL (because the integer-to-string conversion is missing for the PRE_CTRL_TO_PARAMS path in fix_dh_paramgen_type()), and the DH provider then passes this NULL pointer to strcmp() without checking.
build_sh:
#!/bin/bash -eu
cd /src/openssl

# Configure OpenSSL with sanitizers (static build, no apps/tests to save time)
CC=clang CXX=clang++ ./Configure \
    enable-asan enable-ubsan \
    --debug \
    no-shared \
    no-tests \
    no-apps \
    no-docs \
    linux-x86_64

# Build only the crypto library (where the bug lives)
make -j$(nproc) build_libs

# Compile the harness against libcrypto.a
clang -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer \
    -fsanitize=address,undefined \
    -I/src/openssl/include \
    /src/harness.c \
    /src/openssl/libcrypto.a \
    -ldl -lpthread \
    -o /src/harness_bin
secb_sh:
#!/bin/bash

build() {
    echo "BUILDING THE PROJECT..."
    if /usr/local/bin/compile 1>/dev/null; then
        echo "BUILD COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "BUILD FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

repro() {
    echo "REPRODUCING THE ISSUE FOR openssl.issue-30921..."
    export UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1
    /src/harness_bin /testcase/poc.bin
    # NOTE: YOU SHOULD NOT RETURN/EXIT 0 IN THIS FUNCTION.
}

patch() {
    echo "PATCHING THE PROJECT..."
    cd /src/openssl
    if git apply /testcase/model_patch.diff; then
        echo "PATCH APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "PATCH APPLICATION FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    command="$1"
    case "$command" in
        build) build "$@" ;;
        repro) repro "$@" ;;
        patch) patch "$@" ;;
        *) echo "Unknown command: $command"; echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
else
    echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
    exit 1
fi
dockerfile:
FROM hwiwonlee/secb.base:latest
ENV FUZZING_LANGUAGE=c
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git perl make
RUN git clone https://github.com/openssl/openssl.git openssl \
    && cd openssl \
    && git checkout b8df87aca7 \
    && rm -rf .git \
    && git init \
    && git config user.email "secbench@local" \

WORKDIR $SRC/openssl
COPY harness.c $SRC/harness.c
COPY build.sh $SRC/
RUN mkdir -p /testcase
COPY poc.bin /testcase/poc.bin

bug_report:
================= Bug Report (1/1) ==================
## Source: GitHub Issue
## URL: https://github.com/openssl/openssl/issues/30921
## Description:
Issue: openssl/openssl#30921
Title: Null Pointer Dereference in DH Paramgen Type Translation via EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_dh_paramgen_type(0)
State: open
Created at: 2026-04-21
Labels: issue: bug report

Issue Body:
An UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer-reported null pointer dereference occurs in the DH provider keymgmt path when EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_dh_paramgen_type() is called with type = 0.

This is not an API misuse issue. 0 is the documented valid constant DH_PARAMGEN_TYPE_GENERATOR. The crash is caused by an internal translation bug in the legacy EVP_PKEY_CTX_ctrl() to provider-parameter bridge, which constructs an OSSL_PARAM UTF8 string with data == NULL and then passes it into strcmp() inside the DH provider.

The root cause is an internal mismatch between the legacy ctrl-style API and the provider-side parameter format:
- EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_dh_paramgen_type() forwards the integer typ through EVP_PKEY_CTX_ctrl().
- The ctrl-to-provider translation table maps this control to OSSL_PKEY_PARAM_FFC_TYPE, whose provider-side representation is OSSL_PARAM_UTF8_STRING.
- The fixup helper fix_dh_paramgen_type() only converts values for the PRE_CTRL_STR_TO_PARAMS path, where input arrives as a string.
- For the normal PRE_CTRL_TO_PARAMS path used by EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_dh_paramgen_type(ctx, 0), no integer-to-string conversion is performed.
- As a result, the generic translator constructs a UTF8 OSSL_PARAM using ctx->p2 == NULL.
- The DH provider receives a non-NULL OSSL_PARAM *type, but type->data is NULL, and dh_gen_type_name2id_w_default() calls strcmp(name, "default") without checking for NULL first.

Reproduction:
  EVP_PKEY_CTX *ctx = EVP_PKEY_CTX_new_id(EVP_PKEY_DH, NULL);
  EVP_PKEY_paramgen_init(ctx);
  EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_dh_paramgen_type(ctx, 0);

Stack trace:
  #0 dh_gen_type_name2id_w_default providers/implementations/keymgmt/dh_kmgmt.c:89
  #1 dh_gen_common_set_params providers/implementations/keymgmt/dh_kmgmt.c:626
  #2 dh_gen_set_params providers/implementations/keymgmt/dh_kmgmt.c:724
  #3 evp_pkey_ctx_ctrl_to_param crypto/evp/ctrl_params_translate.c:2774
  #4 EVP_PKEY_CTX_ctrl crypto/evp/pmeth_lib.c:1097
  #5 EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_dh_paramgen_type crypto/evp/dh_ctrl.c:86
